children: Brady Corp reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $1.66B and diluted EPS of $4.3, with net income of $205.4M, reflecting year‑over‑year growth as improved product mix and operational gains helped margins.
Revenue was $1661.6M, compared with $1513.6M in the prior year; YoY change 9.8%.
Net income was $205.4M, compared with $189.3M in the prior year; YoY change 8.5%.
Diluted EPS was $4.3, compared with $3.94 in the prior year; YoY change 9.1%.
Revenue growth of 9.8% to $1.662B was driven by 5.3% organic growth and 2.2% from acquisitions.
Americas and Asia led regional performance with 11.4% growth overall; Asia grew roughly 15%, with strong results in India, Singapore and China.
Product strength came from wire, product, safety, facility and healthcare identification businesses, with a higher‑margin product mix supporting improved gross margin (51.7%).

Europe and Australia saw margin improvement following prior‑year reorganizations, and the company completed the Mecco acquisition in August 2025; the PSS acquisition closed Aug. 3, 2026 with integration and financial impacts underway.
